'''Winsafra Watch Out For That Hole!!!! :P''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Winsafra]]
* '''Published:''' 12 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Deal Winsafra DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

luuuke, luuuuuke, dont listen to him, stay in the hole, stay in the hole...
no, of course its not carbon freeze, just stay in that hole away from your father, errr, vader, stay in there away from vader...

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

VS 2.0
Basically, this deck relies on two things, first after you draw your hand, pull the executor, the 2 sites, and hopefully out of your hand or your force pile(which you usually draw up) you'll get either TMNALTC, or an effect puller. get dark deal out and done within the first 2 or 3 turns at latest. if you can't do it, at least get CC Occupation out. use Imp Commands to pull generals and admirals(chiraneu lets the executor drain for 2)
maybe even alert my star destroyer to make it completely immune if you cant get guri up there fast.
other than that, its up to you, thats my basic strategy, the admiral's orders are there for more direct damage and battle destiny cancelling. basically, lots of direct damage fast.
